name: iPlay5
subtitle: PS5 Remote Play for iPhone
description: Local-network PS5 Remote Play built on chiaki-ng. Releases are published automatically from github.com/reefbarman/iPlay5.

apps.name: iPlay5
apps.subtitle: PS5 Remote Play over your local network
apps.localizedDescription:
Requires a game controller (DualSense, Xbox, Backbone, GameSir, etc.): there is no on-screen virtual controller.

Stream your PS5 to your iPhone over Wi-Fi. Hardware HEVC/H.264 decoding with Metal, HDR, up to 1080p60, game controller support with phone gyro, touchscreen as the DualSense touchpad, automatic console discovery and PSN sign-in for linking. Tuned for the iPhone Duo's inner screen, and works on any iPhone running iOS 17 or later.
